mx-world-valle-de-guadalupe-ensenada.basis: Mexico has no legally delimited wine denomination of origin. The outlines are the municipalities of the main wine valleys.
mx-world-valle-de-guadalupe-ensenada.outline: Built from the administrative units that contain the area. The legal boundary follows other lines (roads, rivers, farms or altitude), so the real area is smaller.
mx-world-valle-de-guadalupe-ensenada.note: The 2012 municipality still includes San Quintín, separated in 2020.
